name: FKWD Checkout Roundup for Charity
author: Christina

sections.description:
FKWD Checkout Roundup for Charity lets your customers easily contribute to charity by rounding up their WooCommerce order total to the nearest dollar at checkout.

How it works:

  1. A checkbox appears on the WooCommerce checkout page, whether classic or block-based.
  2. When a customer checks the box, the order total is rounded up to the nearest whole dollar.
  3. The round-up amount is added as a fee to the order.
  4. Store owners can generate monthly reports showing total donations collected.
  5. The store owner manually sends the collected amount to their charity of choice.

Features:

  • Checkbox on both classic and block WooCommerce checkout
  • Customizable checkout label text from the admin settings
  • Automatic round-up calculation to the nearest dollar
  • Monthly reporting with total order count and donation amounts
  • Reports filterable by month for easy bookkeeping
  • Lightweight with no external API calls or third-party services
  • WooCommerce session-based, no extra database tables required
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)

Important notes:

  • This plugin does not automatically send donations to a charity. It provides reports so you can manually distribute collected funds at your preferred interval.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire fkwd-checkout-roundup-for-charity folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen (Plugins > Installed Plugins).
  3. You will find Round Up Report sub-menu under the WooCommerce main menu.
  4. Optionally customize the checkout label text in the Round Up Report settings.

For basic usage, have a look at the plugin’s website for documentation.
sections.faq:
Does this work with the WooCommerce block checkout?

Yes. The round-up checkbox is available on both the classic WooCommerce checkout and the block-based checkout.

Where does the donation money go?

The round-up amounts are collected as order fees within WooCommerce. The plugin provides monthly reports so you can manually distribute the collected funds to the charity of your choice. No money is automatically sent anywhere.

Can I customize the round-up message shown to customers?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce > Round Up Report in your WordPress admin and update the “Checkout Field Label” field to your preferred message. Basic HTML is supported, including links — links automatically open in a new window.

Does the round-up amount include tax?

No. The round-up fee is added as a non-taxable fee to the order.

What happens if the order total is already a whole dollar amount?

If the total is already a whole dollar, the plugin rounds up by a full $1.00.
